text_block_list.text:
After training with Katsuragi Ace, I 
spotted Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ghk... No matter how many times I try, I 
cannot pull off my dream Princess Double 
Jump!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The laws of physics... an insurmountable 
wall at every turn—

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —And with that, you're giving up?

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text: —It's your dream, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A-Appearing backlit by the sunset! That is 
ridiculously cool~~!!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If you're taking on the challenge, I'm 
with you! Time for special training! Let's 
smash through the wall of reality!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Th-This intense heat...! I sense the 
beginning of a fiery training montage, 
just like in episode 27 of PreFie!
choice_data_list: That was moving! Count me in too!
That was moving! I'll join you too!
Rest is also essential for training.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Th-This intense heat...! I sense the 
beginning of a fiery training montage, 
just like in episode 27 of PreFie!
choice_data_list: That was moving! Count me in too!
That was moving! I'll join you too!
Rest is also essential for training.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Alright! Listen up, Kawakami. Don't just 
settle for a double jump!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
If you're gonna take the leap, do it like 
you're jumping out into the whole wide 
world!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Aha...! I see, it wasn't the height of my 
jump that was low, but my ambition...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"I shall become the world-renowned 
Kawakami! With a hop, step, and jump, I'll 
cross all seven seas~!"
choice_data_list:
Alright, let's work on your jumping power 
first!

text_block_list.text:
Their training continued until the sun 
went down...!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
!! ...Kawakami, just how much special 
training did you do?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
A-About half a day... but something like 
this is—!

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
Listen up, Kawakami. Think about your mind 
and body when choosing your races... make 
sure you choose wisely.

text_block_list.name: Katsuragi Ace
text_block_list.text:
—Match the 'Umamusume' inside yourself. It 
doesn't matter if you're a maiden or a G1 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, feels like I got clobbered on the 
head. My eyes are wide awake now.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, both of you! Care to grab some 
tea together? To prepare for tomorrow!
